description:
On the power play during the first period in a game against the Vancouver Canucks, Jack Hughes scored his first career goal which resulted in the lone marker in a 1-0 victory by the New Jersey Devils. Positioned on the right side within the umbrella formation, Hughes found himself in a prime spot as his teammate Taylor Hall delivered an exceptional pass. Receiving the pass, Hughes promptly unleashed a shot that eluded the fully stretched goaltender. The fans in New Jersey's home arena erupted in celebration of the eventual game-deciding goal.

description:
Alex Ovechkin made a remarkable NHL debut by scoring his first two goals in front of an ecstatic Washington crowd. In the first goal, the play unfolded as Dainius Zubrus received the puck below the goal line while Ovechkin positioned himself in the slot, creating an opening. Zubrus then delivered a precise pass to Ovechkin, who unleashed a powerful one-timer that beat the opposing goaltender. Ovechkin's extraordinary rookie season in 2005-06 saw him net 52 goals, the third-highest total by a rookie in NHL history, while also contributing 54 assists on his way to securing the Calder Memorial Trophy.

description:
As Toronto regrouped near their blue line, rookie Auston Matthews curled near center ice as a pass was sent to William Nylander. Nylander executed a skillful move just inside the offensive blue line, carrying the puck deep along the wall before delivering a pass to Matthews in the slot. Although Matthews' initial shot attempt was denied, Zach Hyman eventually fed the puck back to him, and Matthews capitalized with his first career goal, scoring just outside the crease. This marked the beginning of an incredible NHL debut in Ottawa, where Matthews went on to score three more goals – the only player in the NHL’s modern era (since 1943-44) to score four times in his first NHL game. His outstanding rookie season culminated with 40 goals, earning him both the Calder Trophy and widespread acclaim.

description:
Kirill Kaprizov had an impressive NHL debut registering three points in Minnesota’s 4-3 win which included the overtime winner against the Los Angeles Kings. Beginning with an errant pass by the Kings, Kaprizov pounces on the turnover near center ice. After tipping it by the sliding defender, he heads down on a breakaway where he makes a backhand-to-forehand move that redirects off his skate and past the netminder for his first career goal. In his Calder Memorial Trophy-winning season, Kaprizov averaged nearly a point per game amassing 51 points in only 55 games.

description:
On January 7, 2020, in Igor Shesterkin's NHL debut, he secured his first career victory while playing before the home crowd at Madison Square Garden. description:
During a home game against the New York Islanders with a three-goal lead in the midst of the third period, rookie defenseman Victor Hedman showcases his defensive prowess by executing a deft play that results in a turnover, allowing Tampa Bay to shift from defense to offense. Capitalizing on the opportunity, Hedman joins the rush leading to the creation of a 3-on-1 alongside Vincent Lecavalier and Alex Tanguay. As the Islanders' defender attempts to impede the play by sliding down on the ice, Lecavalier sends a saucer pass over to Hedman who buries it past the netminder earning himself the joyous moment of scoring his first career goal. The goal not only solidifies Hedman's defensive capabilities but also showcases his offensive potential, hinting at a bright future for the talented rookie defenseman.

description:
With just under three minutes remaining in the game while holding a one-goal lead, Adam Fox begins with a great defensive read intercepting a shot-pass right in front of the New York Rangers net. Later on the same shift, the Rangers break out of their zone ending up on a two-on-one with a fatigued Tampa Bay Lightning squad on the ice. Fox, with fresher legs, joins the rush where he banks home the rebound off of Chris Kreider’s shot for his first career goal. The insurance marker padded the Rangers lead by two late in the third period. Fox had an impressive rookie season in 2019-20 amassing 42 points and a plus-22 rating in 70 games played.

description:

Elias Pettersson's remarkable performance throughout his rookie season culminated in him being awarded the Calder Memorial Trophy, a testament to his exceptional talents. Over the course of 71 games, he notched an impressive 66 points, solidifying his reputation as a rising star in the NHL.

description:
Wearing #32 for the St. Louis Blues, Tage Thompson scored his first NHL goal on December 21, 2017 which was his sixth career game. On the play, the Blues gain possession of the puck along the left wall in the offensive zone. As the puck moves to the right point, Thompson follows the play making himself available for the pass which finds him right in the high slot. He wastes no time receiving the pass and sending the wrist shot through traffic into the net.
